brief:
An Israeli Jewish politician and former police officer, Yoav Segalowich, has joined the electoral list of the United Arab List ahead of upcoming elections, Shehab Wire reported. Party leader Mansour Abbas announced the candidacy in what represents an unprecedented move in Israeli electoral politics.

The recruitment of Segalowich to an Arab party's slate marks a rare crossing of ethnic and political divides in Israel's fragmented political landscape. Arab parties in Israel have historically fielded exclusively Arab candidates, making the appointment of a Jewish candidate to the United Arab List's roster a notable departure from established electoral patterns.
